parameters.content:
## Missed Call -> WhatsApp Booking
Android phone (MacroDroid) -> n8n -> WhatsApp Cloud API -> Google Calendar + Sheets. No Twilio.

**Setup**
1. Fill in every field in **Config**.
2. Pick your credentials on the WhatsApp, Google Calendar and Google Sheets nodes.
3. Click **Run Setup Once** (one time).
4. Publish (activate) the workflow.

Follow the setup guide for every step.

## Part A - Missed call
MacroDroid sends the caller number + secret. The number is cleaned (0300... -> 92300...), repeat calls inside DEDUPE_MINUTES are skipped, callers marked opted_out in the Leads sheet are skipped, and the WhatsApp template with 2 buttons is sent.

## Part B - WhatsApp replies
**Book a visit**: free times from Google Calendar (up to 10).
**Picked a time**: re-checks the slot, creates the event, asks for the address.
**Call me back**: reminder on the owner's calendar.
**Text / location**: added to an upcoming booking, otherwise answered with the 2 buttons.
**Delivery failed**: error 131026 (no WhatsApp) can send an SMS from the phone.

## Send + log (shared)
Every branch ends here: send the WhatsApp message (errors are caught and logged), then update one row per customer in the **Leads** tab (matched on phone). Only the columns that changed are written.

## One-time setup
Run **Run Setup Once** after adding the WhatsApp credential. It connects your Meta app to your WhatsApp Business Account so customer replies reach n8n (success: true also proves the token works).

When you move to a real number, put a 6-digit PIN in Config > WA_REGISTER_PIN and run it again: it also registers the number for the Cloud API.
